title: Inventory and orders
summary: A small shop tracks items, stock moves, suppliers, customers, purchase receipts and sales fulfilment.

entryPoints.summary: Sign in with an invited staff or owner account.
Track stock, receive purchase orders and fulfil sales orders.
Manage locations, contacts, categories, statuses and staff invitations.
Choose or change owner sign-in details.
Choose a password from a single-use staff invitation.
Request a password reset when email is available.
Choose a password from a reset link.

owner.summary: Runs the shop and edits prices, orders, settings and staff.

staff.summary: Signs in, reads shop stock, receives purchase orders and fulfils sales orders.

visitor.summary: Sees sign-in, invite and reset pages only.

journeys.summary: Reads stock and the move ledger.
Creates and receives a purchase order.
Fulfils a sales order without making stock negative.
Records a counted quantity with a reason.
Adds and removes a category and keeps a category in use.
Creates a single-use invitation for staff.
Opens settings through the owner pass.
A signed-out visitor cannot read stock.
Explains that password reset needs email.
Emails the supplier a purchase order.
Imports and exports item CSV and exports stock moves.
journeys.reason: Checklist actions cannot upload or inspect downloaded files. The headless walk and database tests verify the bytes.

notIncluded: Email delivery requires the platform email module and a configured sender; off by default. Invitations can be passed on as one-time links.
Going live requires a platform live database; off by default.
No public sign-up. Each kit instance serves one shop; staff share that shop and other account roles have no access.
Staff cannot edit prices, settings, counts or create orders.
No partial receipts or partial fulfilment, returns, order edits, shipping, payments or accounting sync.
All prices are decimal amounts in the shop's own single currency; no exchange rates or tax calculation.
Low-stock notices are owner-triggered and deduplicated by recipient and current stock summary.
CSV imports add up to fifty new items per file; duplicate SKUs reject the whole import.
A member resets a password only with a verified email and email enabled; no signed-in staff password change.
